```python
import requests

api_key = "my_api"
url = (
    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/youtube.com/comments?"
    f"limit=10&continuation={\"abc\"}"
)
headers = {"x-apikey": api_key}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```

Replace `"my_api"` with your actual API key. This will return up to ten comment records starting after the cursor `abc`. If you run into rate limits or authentication errors, double‑check your key and ensure you’re following VirusTotal’s usage policies.
